description: TriggerFish VCA: a voltage-controlled amplifier modelled on a transistor circuit, with separate linear and exponential control inputs

params.text: Drives the transistor core into saturation; the level change it causes is compensated, so it changes the tone rather than the volume
Attenuates the linear control input, 0 to 100%
Attenuates the exponential control input, 0 to 100%
Sets how much of the control signal leaks into the audio output, reaching -20dB at full and high-passed at 10Hz
Sets the base of the exponential control law, 2 to 50

outputs.text: The amplified audio, high-passed at 5Hz to remove the DC the nonlinear core leaves behind

notes: an unpatched control input contributes nothing, so with neither control jack patched the output is silent

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
